sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2022 5-year estimates
sources.usedFor: Haitian ancestry (B04006), population (B01003), Haitian Creole speakers (C16001), internet (B28002), educational attainment (B15003)

sources.name: NYC Open Data, Modified ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (MODZCTA)
NYC Open Data, Public Library Locations
NYC Open Data, 2018–2019 School-Level Detailed Report Card
sources.usedFor: School locations and performance (graduation, attendance, ELL programs)

processing.needMethod: Composite education need = 40% Haitian-ancestry share rank + 30% households-without-internet rank + 30% adults-without-HS-diploma rank, ranked among reliable ZIPs in the metro.
processing.tierMethod: High / medium / low = top / middle / bottom third (33rd and 67th percentiles) among reliable ZIPs in the metro, computed separately for population share and composite score.

warnings: 29 of 177 ZIPs have too few residents (under 500 total or under 10 Haitian ancestry) for reliable estimates and are tiered "insufficient_data".
1 schools fall outside every mapped ZIP (zip = null).
ACS figures are 5-year survey estimates with margins of error not shown here.
